name: Audio description
description: Finds films and series in Jellyfin with a described sound track for blind and partially sighted people, and prefers releases with one in Reelix.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Prefer releases with audio description
settings.hint: Adds an Audio description format to Reelix and prefers it in every quality level. Reelix still takes a release without it when there is no other.

settings.label: AudioVault search links
settings.hint: A link to AudioVault's own search for each film and series without audio description. Starboard never downloads from AudioVault or reads its pages.

settings.label: YouDescribe search links
settings.hint: A link to YouDescribe's own search for each film and series, for described trailers and clips on YouTube. Nothing is fetched from YouDescribe.
